principles.title: How I take an idea to production.
principles.description: A process connecting operations to implementation.

operations.title: Understand the workflow
operations.description: Identify who does the work, what information they need and what happens when something fails.

architecture.title: Define the boundaries
architecture.description: Model permissions, data and contracts before connecting interfaces to the backend.

delivery.title: Test what comes next
delivery.description: Check the complete flow: saving, returning, cancelling and retrying. Delivery includes operation.

projects.title: Products that connect operations.
projects.description: Six products built around concrete operational problems, with a technical foundation designed to grow without losing control.

poultry.title: Poultry
poultry.tagline: Operational traceability from the poultry house to management.
poultry.problem: Poultry production distributes critical information across facilities, flocks, inventory, and teams with different responsibilities.
poultry.contribution: Design and development of a multi-tenant foundation with resource and branch authorization, auditability, and connected operational workflows.

image.alt: Poultry homepage presenting its poultry management platform.
image.caption: Poultry · Poultry ERP homepage.

wwt.title: WWT
wwt.tagline: Internal work organized, visible, and traceable.
wwt.problem: Documents, requests, and tasks lose context when they live in separate channels without shared follow-up.
wwt.contribution: Architecture and development of document, request, and workflow modules with permissions, notifications, and traceability.

trackly.title: Trackly
trackly.tagline: Fleet location and activity turned into operational context.
trackly.problem: Coordinating vehicles requires location and activity signals in one view that helps teams act quickly.
trackly.contribution: Full-stack development of operational views that organize fleet location and activity for daily use.

nuptia.title: Nuptia
nuptia.tagline: Invitations and guest coordination in one workflow.
nuptia.problem: Organizing an event combines confirmations, guests, gifts, and logistics that are often managed in disconnected tools.
nuptia.contribution: Multi-tenant architecture and development of invitation, RSVP, role, reporting, and guest organization workflows.

nutry.title: Nutry
nutry.tagline: Nutrition consultations, recipes, and planning connected.
nutry.problem: Nutrition professionals need to bring patients, assessments, recipes, plans, and follow-up together without duplicating work.
nutry.contribution: Architecture and development of clinical management, recipes, and assisted meal-plan generation grounded in real system data.

image.alt: Nutry homepage presenting its nutrition software and professional access.
image.caption: Nutry · Nutrition software homepage.

medisenda.title: Medisenda
medisenda.tagline: Coming soon at medisenda.cl: a new digital experience for healthcare coordination.
medisenda.problem: The product scope is being validated before a definitive proposition is published.
medisenda.contribution: Initial product definition and a technical foundation ready to evolve once the scope is validated.

projects.evidenceNote: Images show the Poultry and Nutry homepages. Visit each site to explore its scope and access the product.

falabella.summary: Transportation systems and carrier payment requests integrated with SAP. Development of tax solutions for Chile, Peru and Colombia.

carpetres.summary: Corporate intranets with portals, documents, chat and galleries. Angular and Node.js development, plus interface prototypes.

innoapsion.summary: Web and Android applications for operational checklists, employee management, roles and reports.
